modesNote: 15/10/2026 (#1375): JA Podcast's light/dark switch (.ja-dark-mode) marks the dark side with body.dark-active and keeps the visitor's choice in a cookie; a page without the class is light whatever the OS says. The contract it extends hid the switch under every system, which ADR 0031 decision 3 calls a bug (MODE-2 failed). From 1.0.5 on, the release's template.js opens the page on the worn system's side (the slot's /* mode: */ line) while the visitor has chosen none, so both sides are worn and the switch stays; releases up to the one the base contract confirms keep one look.
